phantom_busters_tv_anime_manga_anime_ada.summary: A television anime adaptation of Shoco's Phantom Busters manga was announced via the official website, slated for a 2027 release.
highlights: The anime was confirmed on the series' official website with a commemorative illustration
The manga originated as a one‑shot in Jump SQ.Rise (2022) and serialized in Jump SQ. starting August 2023
The series has sold over 1.4 million copies worldwide, with English licensing by VIZ Media
The eighth manga volume is scheduled for release on October 2, 2026
phantom_busters_tv_anime_manga_anime_ada.why_it_matters: The adaptation brings a popular, high‑circulation manga to a broader TV audience, expanding its international fanbase.

comicbook.com/movies/news/the-dcus-final.headline: Why Clayface Marks a Dark Turn for the DCU

avengers_doomsday_early_release_change.headline: Adventure Time: Side Quests Season 2 Trailer Released
avengers_doomsday_early_release_change.summary: A new trailer reveals Season 2 of Adventure Time: Side Quests, returning Finn and Jake with deep‑cut characters and a fresh art style.
highlights: The trailer showcases fan‑favorite deep‑cut characters such as Banana Man
Season 2 will stream on Disney+ and Hulu starting October 2, 2026
The series explores younger versions of Finn and Jake with a painting‑like visual style
avengers_doomsday_early_release_change.why_it_matters: It expands the Adventure Time universe with fresh storytelling and visual direction, appealing to both longtime fans and new viewers.

norimitsu_kaih_kurageso_s_akarui_mirai_m.headline: Akarui Mirai
norimitsu_kaih_kurageso_s_akarui_mirai_m.summary: Norimitsu Kaihō and Kurageso’s Akarui Mirai manga will conclude with its next chapter in the October 23 issue of Manga Time Kirara Forward.
highlights: The series began serialization in August 2025 in Houbunsha’s Manga Time Kirara Forward
Second compiled volume was released on July 10, 2026
The final chapter is scheduled for the October 23, 2026 issue
Creator Norimitsu Kaihō is known for School-Live! and other notable works
norimitsu_kaih_kurageso_s_akarui_mirai_m.why_it_matters: The ending marks the close of a short‑run series by a creator famed for influential survival‑genre manga, offering fans a definitive conclusion.

disney_confirms_an_earlier_avengers_doom.headline: Avengers: Doomsday
disney_confirms_an_earlier_avengers_doom.summary: Disney has moved the UK theatrical release of Avengers: Doomsday up two days to December 16, 2026, while the worldwide release remains December 18, 2026.
highlights: The earlier date applies only to theatergoers in the United Kingdom
The change was confirmed by Disney via Empire Magazine reporting
Previous MCU films such as Infinity War and Endgame also opened a day or two earlier in the UK
Fans fear the staggered release could lead to spoilers and leaks
disney_confirms_an_earlier_avengers_doom.why_it_matters: A staggered release risks spoiling the film for global audiences and may fuel fan backlash over perceived unfairness.

gachiakuta_drops_new_look_coolest_ahead_.headline: Gachiakuta Season 2 First‑Look Trailer Released
gachiakuta_drops_new_look_coolest_ahead_.summary: A first‑look trailer for Gachiakuta Season 2 was unveiled, confirming the upcoming anime sequel.
highlights: The trailer premiered at Anime Expo 2026 and the 25th Comic Exhibition in Taipei
Season 2 will stream on Crunchyroll, though no release date has been announced yet
The original series ran 24 episodes from July to December 2025, produced by Studio Bones
gachiakuta_drops_new_look_coolest_ahead_.why_it_matters: Season 2 continues the acclaimed shonen series that dominated 2025, raising expectations for its next narrative arc.

that_we_draw_anime_reveals_first_january.headline: Now That We Draw
that_we_draw_anime_reveals_first_january.summary: The romantic‑comedy manga Now That We Draw received its first teaser trailer and a January 2027 premiere date.
highlights: First teaser trailer unveiled
Director Shunsuke Ishikawa and studio ROLL2 confirmed
Series composition by Deko Akao and character design by Hiromi Nakagawa
Lead voice cast Ayumu Murase as Yuuki Uehara and Sayumi Suzushiro as Niina Miyamoto
that_we_draw_anime_reveals_first_january.why_it_matters: It marks the first animated adaptation of a popular seinen rom‑com manga, expanding its audience ahead of a 2027 debut.

robert_pattinson_batman_crossover_gunn.headline: Boba Fett Standalone Film Cancelled
robert_pattinson_batman_crossover_gunn.summary: A planned Boba Fett movie, initially attached to director Josh Trank and later James Mangold, was abandoned after development stalled at Lucasfilm.
highlights: Josh Trank was reported to direct the Boba Fett film with Simon Kinberg involved
The project was slated for a reveal at Star Wars Celebration 2015 but was pulled
A later attempt with James Mangold also failed to reach production
The character later appeared in The Mandalorian and received a Disney+ series, The Book of Boba Fett
robert_pattinson_batman_crossover_gunn.why_it_matters: The cancellation shows Lucasfilm’s shifting strategy for standalone Star Wars films, redirecting the character to successful streaming series instead.

nycc_skybound_teases_new_comic_book_line.headline: Skybound new comics line (teased)
nycc_skybound_teases_new_comic_book_line.summary: Skybound will announce a new comics line during its NYCC panel "Vision for the Future" on October 9, 2026.
highlights: The announcement will be made at the Skybound Comics: Vision for the Future panel on Friday, October 9 at Javits Center
Panel will feature creators Stephen Graham Jones, Leandro Fernández, Tate Brombal, Matt Emmons, Doug Mahnke, and Executive Editor Ben Abernathy
The new line is expected to expand Skybound’s offerings beyond the Energon Universe, which includes Transformers, G.I. Joe, Void Rivals, and M.A.S.K.
nycc_skybound_teases_new_comic_book_line.why_it_matters: A new Skybound line could reshape the publisher’s portfolio and offer fresh storytelling opportunities for fans of its flagship franchises.

marvel_comics_full_december_solicits_and.headline: Marvel December 2026 Solicits Reveal New Post‑Armageddon Titles
marvel_comics_full_december_solicits_and.summary: Marvel Comics released its full December 2026 solicit list, introducing new series like Maximum X‑Men, Fugitive X‑Force and several Midnight one‑shots.
highlights: Maximum X‑Men #1 launches a new mutant team after the Armageddon event
Fugitive X‑Force #1 starts a five‑issue run with a new leader for the team
Midnight X‑Men, Midnight Fantastic Four and Midnight Spider‑Man continue with issue #3 each
Avengers #2 returns with a demonic invasion storyline featuring Mephisto
marvel_comics_full_december_solicits_and.why_it_matters: The lineup expands Marvel's post‑Armageddon universe and sets up major crossover threads for upcoming events.

crunchyroll_screens_dive_wonderland_film.headline: Dive in Wonderland (Fushigi no Kuni de Alice to)
crunchyroll_screens_dive_wonderland_film.summary: Crunchyroll will screen the anime film Dive in Wonderland in select U.S. theaters on November 16 as part of its Anime Nights program.
highlights: The film opened in Japan on August 29, 2025 and is the first Japanese theatrical anime adaptation of Lewis Carroll's Alice in Wonderland
Directed by Toshiya Shinohara with a script by Yūko Kakihara, produced by P.A. Works
Crunchyroll will present a one‑day theatrical event on November 16 across the United States
SEKAI NO OWARI performs the theme song "Zukan" for the film
crunchyroll_screens_dive_wonderland_film.why_it_matters: It marks the first U.S. theatrical showcase of this landmark anime adaptation, expanding its international exposure beyond streaming

erica_schultz_gary_erskine_create_murder.headline: Murderbot Diaries: All Systems Red – Graphic Novel
erica_schultz_gary_erskine_create_murder.summary: The first Murderbot graphic novel, adapted by Erica Schultz and Gary Erskine, launches as a Kickstarter exclusive on October 15, 2026.
highlights: Adapted by Erica Schultz (Daredevil, Spawn, X‑Men) and Gary Erskine (Dan Dare, Hellblazer, Punisher, Wolverine)
Includes a brand‑new Murderbot short story by author Martha Wells, exclusive to the graphic novel
Kickstarter launch on October 15 with limited collectible editions and variant covers by Tommy Arnold, John Picacio, and Francesca Myman
Retail edition slated for early 2028
erica_schultz_gary_erskine_create_murder.why_it_matters: It expands the award‑winning Murderbot universe into comics, offering fans new canonical content and a chance to support the project directly via Kickstarter.

cinema_is_healing_why_gremlins_has_fans_.headline: Gremlins 3
highlights: The teaser reveals the sequel’s release has been moved from November 19 2027 to October 6 2028.
Gizmo appears as a physical animatronic puppet, echoing the original 1984 design by Chris Walas.
Chris Columbus returns as director and Steven Spielberg is credited as executive producer.
The film will be the first live‑action Gremlins movie since 1990’s Gremlins 2.
cinema_is_healing_why_gremlins_has_fans_.why_it_matters: The use of practical puppetry signals a return to the franchise’s classic aesthetic while the new 2028 date gives fans a concrete timeline.

sekiro_no_defeat_tv_anime_2027.headline: SEKIRO: NO DEFEAT (TV Anime)
sekiro_no_defeat_tv_anime_2027.summary: The eight‑episode SEKIRO: NO DEFEAT TV anime will premiere in January 2027, expanding on the recently released theatrical version.
highlights: The series will run for eight episodes, releasing weekly starting January 2027
It adds new scenes and cuts not present in the theatrical film
Directed by Kenichi Kutsuna with staff including screenwriter Takuya Satou and character designer Takahiro Kishida
Produced by studio Qzil.la and will stream worldwide on Crunchyroll (excluding Japan and several regions)
sekiro_no_defeat_tv_anime_2027.why_it_matters: It offers fans a more complete adaptation of the FromSoftware game, delivering content beyond the limited‑run film.

one_the_best_thrillers_the_2010s_officia.headline: The Girl With The Dragon Tattoo (TV series reboot)
one_the_best_thrillers_the_2010s_officia.summary: Sky is developing a new TV adaptation of Stieg Larsson’s Millennium series with David Oyelowo as Mikael Blomkvist and Viola Prettejohn as Lisbeth Salander.
highlights: David Oyelowo cast as journalist Mikael Blomkvist, sparking casting controversy
Viola Prettejohn cast as iconic hacker Lisbeth Salander
Series produced by Sky with creative team led by Reinaldo Marcus Green and Left Bank Pictures
Series is currently in development and will air on Sky
one_the_best_thrillers_the_2010s_officia.why_it_matters: The diverse casting reimagines a beloved character, potentially reshaping audience perception of the franchise.

the_apothecary_diaries_star_teases_the_b.headline: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3
the_apothecary_diaries_star_teases_the_b.summary: The third season of The Apothecary Diaries will debut on October 2, 2026 in a split‑cour format, with the second half slated for April 2027.
highlights: First cour premieres October 2, 2026, second cour scheduled for April 2027
The season will adapt Volume 5 of the light novel and introduce a new cast member, Reina Ueda as Bai Niangniang
Crunchyroll will stream the series and provide an English dub
Directed by Akinori Fudesaka at OLM with series composition by Norihiko Naganuma
the_apothecary_diaries_star_teases_the_b.why_it_matters: The split‑cour release extends the franchise’s momentum and promises significant story and tonal shifts highlighted by the cast.

chiikawa_anime_temporarily_halt_new_epis.headline: Chiikawa Anime Temporarily Pauses New Episodes for Revival Rebroadcast
chiikawa_anime_temporarily_halt_new_epis.summary: The Chiikawa TV anime will temporarily halt regular new episodes and air a revival rebroadcast of 25 influential episodes until December 25, 2026.
highlights: The revival rebroadcast will focus on early episodes and those linked to the recent film Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island
The pause runs from April 2026 through December 25, 2026, after which new episodes are expected to resume
Sentai Filmworks continues to license the series, streaming it on HIDIVE with English subtitles
The series originally premiered in April 2022 and shifted to a twice‑weekly schedule in April 2023
chiikawa_anime_temporarily_halt_new_epis.why_it_matters: The pause gives fans a chance to revisit key episodes while the studio prepares the next season, maintaining audience engagement.

spaceopera_final_chapter_2026.headline: Be Forever Yamato: REBEL3199 Chapter 7: Rainbow Samsara
spaceopera_final_chapter_2026.summary: Bandai Namco Filmworks released the full trailer for the final chapter of the Space Battleship Yamato remake, set to debut in Japanese theaters on October 30, 2026.
highlights: The trailer showcases epic battles on Earth and in space for the series' climactic finale
The seventh chapter concludes the seven‑part, 26‑episode remake that began in July 2024
The film will open in Japan on October 30, 2026, following the June 26 release of Chapter 6
The series holds a 7.6/10 IMDb rating and a 4.8/5 rating on Crunchyroll
spaceopera_final_chapter_2026.why_it_matters: It marks the conclusion of a highly acclaimed revival of a classic mecha franchise, drawing both longtime fans and new audiences.

ignition_press_full_december_solicits_ma.headline: Ignition Press December 2026 Solicits
ignition_press_full_december_solicits_ma.summary: Ignition Press released its full December 2026 solicit list, featuring new and concluding issues across eleven horror, sci‑fi and fantasy titles.
highlights: The line‑up includes continuing arcs for 12 Foot Skeleton, Arcadia, The Beauty, Cult‑de‑Sac and Dinner Date
Final issues are slated for Dispatched and Sicko while Prima Apparata reaches its penultimate chapter
Mad Science Division, Minotaur and Rampant Swine add new chaos‑driven horror entries for December
Key creators such as Aaron Campbell, Tim Seeley, Ben Templesmith, Cullen Bunn and Si Spurrier return on multiple titles
ignition_press_full_december_solicits_ma.why_it_matters: The solicit highlights Ignition Press’s commitment to expanding its horror‑centric indie lineup while wrapping up several ongoing series.

sekiro_anime_jan2027.headline: Sekiro: No Defeat
sekiro_anime_jan2027.summary: The Sekiro: No Defeat anime will be re-edited into an eight‑episode TV series that streams on Crunchyroll in January.
highlights: Eight‑episode TV format will reconstruct the theatrical film
Crunchyroll will stream the series worldwide except Japan, China, Korea, Russia, and Belarus
Original game cast reprise their roles, including Daisuke Namikawa as Sekiro
Directed by Kenichi Kutsuna at studio Qzil.la
sekiro_anime_jan2027.why_it_matters: Fans of the award‑winning game can now follow the story in a serialized format, expanding the franchise’s reach.

mission_yozakura_family_s_video_reveals_.headline: Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 Part 2
mission_yozakura_family_s_video_reveals_.summary: A new promotional video for the second cour of Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 reveals five additional cast members and confirms its October 11 premiere.
highlights: Hōchū Ōtsuka, Miku Itō, Yumiri Hanamori, Sumire Uesaka, and Naomi Shindoh join the cast
The second cour will debut on MBS, TBS and 26 other channels on October 11, 2026
Opening theme "Forever Song" is performed by Humbreaders and ending theme "I'm Still Breathing" by KID PHENOMENON
Chief director Mirai Minato returns at studio SILVER LINK
mission_yozakura_family_s_video_reveals_.why_it_matters: The added voice talent expands the series' character roster as the story enters its most pivotal arc.

the_fake_alchemist_anime_s_unveils_staff.headline: The Fake Alchemist
the_fake_alchemist_anime_s_unveils_staff.summary: Kadokawa released a teaser revealing the cast, staff, and Passione as the animation studio for the upcoming TV anime adaptation of The Fake Alchemist manga.
highlights: Yōhei Matsuoka voices Paracelsus and Miyari Nemoto voices Nora
Takeo Takahashi serves as chief director with Hijiri Sanpei as director
Kenta Ihara handles series scripts; Yuka Takashina designs characters; Luke Standridge composes music
Passione is confirmed as the animation studio
the_fake_alchemist_anime_s_unveils_staff.why_it_matters: The reveal confirms a high‑profile production team for a manga that has already sold over one million copies, raising expectations for a major 2026 fall anime season.

mtg_mage_of_zhalfir_dark_horse_2027.headline: Magic: The Gathering: Mage of Zhalfir
mtg_mage_of_zhalfir_dark_horse_2027.summary: Dark Horse Comics will launch the twelve‑issue series Magic: The Gathering: Mage of Zhalfir in January 2027, exploring Teferi Akosa’s Year One at the Tolarian Academy.
highlights: The series is a 12‑issue run debuting on 20 January 2027
Written by Ray Fawkes with Rapha Lobosco and Jão Canola penciling the first four issues
Covers are illustrated by Paris Alleyne and Mateus Manhanini
Lettering is provided by AndWorld Design
mtg_mage_of_zhalfir_dark_horse_2027.why_it_matters: It expands the Magic: The Gathering lore in comics, giving fans a deep look at a major planeswalker’s origins.

penguin_gives_an_english_bookshop_a_gran.headline: Penguin Gives An English Bookshop A Grant To Fund Kids Reading Comics
penguin_gives_an_english_bookshop_a_gran.summary: Penguin Random House UK awarded a grant to The Children’s Bookshelf in Hereford to run a manga and graphic‑novel reading programme for Year 5‑6 pupils.
highlights: Over 40 independent UK bookshops received grants from the £150,000 Children’s Bookshop Grant 2026
The Children’s Bookshelf secured funding for 30 fully‑funded places targeting reluctant, neurodivergent and dyslexic readers
The project will use manga, graphic novels and illustrated fiction in short workshops and personalised reading packs
Sessions are scheduled after the Halloween half‑term and throughout December 2026
penguin_gives_an_english_bookshop_a_gran.why_it_matters: The initiative uses visual storytelling to engage reluctant readers and supports inclusive literacy development in UK schools.

sheena_and_pigeon_spies_highest_graded_s.headline: Sheena, Queen of the Jungle #2 (Fiction House, 1942)
sheena_and_pigeon_spies_highest_graded_s.summary: A CGC‑graded 9.2 copy of Sheena, Queen of the Jungle #2 is slated for auction at the September 2026 Comic Books Signature Auction.
highlights: The issue features Sheena battling Nazi pigeon spies in the wartime story "Swastika Plague."
Bob Webb’s art blends jungle adventure with WWII intrigue, including leopard cults and vampire vultures.
Only one CGC 9.2 Rockford pedigree copy exists among 20 Universal certifications.
The auction will run September 24‑26, 2026 as part of Comic Books Signature Auction #7469.
sheena_and_pigeon_spies_highest_graded_s.why_it_matters: The high grade underscores the rarity and enduring collector interest in early Fiction House titles.

years_ago_today_an_original_superhero_se.headline: Heroes
years_ago_today_an_original_superhero_se.summary: The original superhero series Heroes premiered on NBC 20 years ago, drawing 14.1 million viewers with its iconic “Save the cheerleader, save the world” tagline.
highlights: Heroes debuted on September 25 2006 with the episode “Genesis,” attracting 14.1 million viewers
The series was created by Tim Kring and introduced a team of young people with superhuman powers
Its simple tagline “Save the cheerleader, save the world” became a viral marketing hook
The first season maintained high ratings, while viewership declined in later seasons, ending with 4.41 million viewers for the finale
years_ago_today_an_original_superhero_se.why_it_matters: Heroes proved that an original, non‑comic‑book‑based superhero show could achieve mainstream success before the Arrowverse era.

rebellion_solaris_sale_profile_books_202.headline: Rebellion Sells Solaris Imprint to Profile Books
rebellion_solaris_sale_profile_books_202.summary: Rebellion Publishing has sold its Solaris sci‑fi/fantasy/horror imprint to Profile Books for an undisclosed sum.
highlights: Solaris, founded in 2007 and acquired by Rebellion in 2010, publishes 30‑35 titles per year including award‑winning works
Five Rebellion staff members transferred to Profile Books as part of the deal
The sale includes a shift of both digital and print distribution to Profile’s partners
Solaris’ roster features authors such as Adrian Tchaikovsky, Rebecca Roanhorse, and the award‑winning novel Rakesfall
rebellion_solaris_sale_profile_books_202.why_it_matters: The transfer positions Solaris under a dedicated publisher, potentially expanding its reach and supporting its acclaimed SFF and horror titles.

animenewsnetwork.com/news/2026-09-25/mis.headline: Why New Cast Members Matter for Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 Part 2

ttgtss_s4_part3_2027.headline: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 4
ttgtss_s4_part3_2027.summary: The fourth season of the anime will continue with its third cour in July 2027, while the Clayman's Revenge spinoff anime debuts in April 2027.
highlights: Third cour of Season 4 scheduled for July 2027
Clayman's Revenge spinoff anime set to premiere in April 2027
8‑Bit returns as animation studio for both projects
Crunchyroll will stream the new episodes as they air
ttgtss_s4_part3_2027.why_it_matters: Extending the popular franchise into 2027 keeps fans engaged and introduces new storylines from the manga spin‑off.

tatsuki_fujimoto_anime_my_melody_kuromi_.headline: Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 Anime, My Melody & Kuromi Stop‑Motion Series Nominated for International Emmy
tatsuki_fujimoto_anime_my_melody_kuromi_.summary: The eight‑episode stop‑motion anthology based on Tatsuki Fujimoto’s pre‑Chainsaw Man one‑shots has been nominated for an International Emmy award.
highlights: World premiere at Global Stage Hollywood Film Festival in October 2025
Limited two‑week theatrical runs in Japan and South Korea
Series directed by Tomoki Misato at TORUKU (WIT STUDIO) with scripts by Shūko Nemoto
Nominated for International Emmy with winners to be announced November 23
tatsuki_fujimoto_anime_my_melody_kuromi_.why_it_matters: An International Emmy nomination highlights the growing global recognition of Japanese stop‑motion animation.

after_year_wait_american_horror_story_ro.headline: Horror Collector
after_year_wait_american_horror_story_ro.summary: NHK released a teaser trailer for the upcoming anime adaptation of the Horror Collector novel series, confirming an October 10, 2026 premiere.
highlights: The 12‑episode series will debut on October 10, 2026 and is produced by Studio Palette.
Main cast includes Hiiro Ishibashi as Fushigi Senno, Jun Fukuyama as Jimmy, Saori Hayami as Himitsu, and Nobuhiko Okamoto as Blue Umbrella Man.
Yuki Inaba serves as director and series composer, with character designs by Kaori Yoshikawa and music by Masato Koda.
The original novels have sold over one million copies worldwide and Yen Press publishes the English version.
after_year_wait_american_horror_story_ro.why_it_matters: It marks the first anime adaptation of a bestselling Japanese children’s horror series, expanding its international reach.

dc_dynamic_duo_cast_2026.headline: Batman & Robin: Year One – Dynamic Duos
dc_dynamic_duo_cast_2026.summary: DC announced a new 12‑issue comic series titled Batman & Robin: Year One – Dynamic Duos launching August 12, 2026.
highlights: Written by Mark Waid and Chris Samnee, the creators of the original Batman & Robin: Year One
Features variant covers by Marc Silvestri, Dustin Nguyen, Hayden Sherman, and a Dark Knight Returns 40th‑anniversary cover by Greg Capullo
Explores the early partnership of Bruce Wayne and Dick Grayson with a new storyline involving Catwoman and a mysterious crime boss
Retail price set at $4.99 for the main cover and $5.99 for variant covers
dc_dynamic_duo_cast_2026.why_it_matters: Expands the acclaimed Year One narrative, deepening the origins of DC’s iconic duo for both longtime fans and new readers.

baltimore_comic_con_kicks_off_today_majo.headline: Baltimore Comic Con 2026
baltimore_comic_con_kicks_off_today_majo.summary: Baltimore Comic Con kicks off on September 25, 2026, featuring a star‑studded comics guest list and multiple creator panels.
highlights: Headlined by Chris Claremont and Jim Lee with guests like Jason Aaron, Chip Zdarsky, and Garth Ennis
Panels include "Absolute DC: Batman, Superman, and Beyond" with Jason Aaron, Che Grayson, and Scott Snyder
Advent Comics celebrates its 17th anniversary with a panel on the Epiphany Engine graphic novel
The Ringo Awards will be presented on Saturday night
baltimore_comic_con_kicks_off_today_majo.why_it_matters: The con gathers leading creators and celebrates key milestones, offering fans direct access to industry talent and upcoming projects.

code_geass_aspal_2027_announcement.headline: Code Geass: Hoshi Oi no Aspal
code_geass_aspal_2027_announcement.summary: A teaser trailer for the new Code Geass anime was released, confirming a 2027 premiere.
highlights: Teaser trailer streamed on the official Code Geass YouTube channel
The series is set to debut in 2027
Directed by Kazuya Nomura with series scripts by Mado Nozaki and character design by Rolua
The 20th anniversary exhibition will open in Tokyo in September 2026 and Osaka in November 2026
code_geass_aspal_2027_announcement.why_it_matters: It adds a fresh entry to the long‑running Code Geass franchise as part of its 20th‑anniversary celebration.

north_american_anime_manga_releases_sept.headline: ChaO
north_american_anime_manga_releases_sept.summary: The original net animation ChaO will receive a Blu‑ray Disc release in North America on September 22, 2026.
highlights: Blu‑ray released by Shout! Studios
Retail price set at US$29.98
Release scheduled for September 22, 2026
north_american_anime_manga_releases_sept.why_it_matters: ChaO’s home‑video release makes the series widely accessible for collectors and new fans alike.

visionquest_new_seemingly_has_a_human_to.headline: VisionQuest
visionquest_new_seemingly_has_a_human_to.summary: Marvel Studios released a new trailer for the Disney+ series VisionQuest, revealing the live‑action debut of Jim Hammond, the original Human Torch.
highlights: The 34‑second trailer features Paul Bettany’s White Vision searching for his identity after WandaVision
It introduces Jim Hammond, the 1939 original Human Torch, rather than the Fantastic Four’s Johnny Storm
James Spader returns as the voice of Ultron, hinting at a conflict with Vision
VisionQuest is set to premiere on Disney+ on October 14, 2026
visionquest_new_seemingly_has_a_human_to.why_it_matters: The trailer ties the classic Human Torch origin to Vision’s storyline, deepening MCU lore ahead of the series’ debut.

netflix_s_most_adult_anime_just_ended_an.headline: Chainsmoker Cat
netflix_s_most_adult_anime_just_ended_an.summary: The adult‑oriented anime Chainsmoker Cat concluded its 12‑episode run in Summer 2026 on Netflix.
highlights: The series aired its final episode in the summer of 2026, wrapping up the story after 12 episodes.
A special music video featuring the main cast covering the opening theme was released to celebrate the conclusion.
The anime was directed by Taku Kimura at Bibury Animation Studios and streamed worldwide by Netflix.
The original manga is serialized by Nyan Nyan Factory in Kodansha's Weekly Young Magazine, with English releases by Seven Seas Entertainment.
netflix_s_most_adult_anime_just_ended_an.why_it_matters: Its bold dark‑comedy premise and controversial smoking theme sparked debate, making its conclusion a notable moment for adult anime fans.

omega_level_mutants_we_want_see_the_mcu_.headline: Storm Joins the Avengers
omega_level_mutants_we_want_see_the_mcu_.summary: Marvel confirmed that Storm will become a member of the Avengers in the MCU.
highlights: Storm is officially joining the Avengers as announced by Marvel
The announcement was made in Avengers #17, published May 17, 2024
Storm’s inclusion expands the mutant roster within the MCU
omega_level_mutants_we_want_see_the_mcu_.why_it_matters: Integrating Storm into the Avengers ties the X‑Men franchise directly into the core MCU team, promising new team dynamics and story possibilities.

years_later_classic_fantasy_revival_kick.why_it_matters: The trailer highlights the growing trend of classic 1990s shojo manga finally receiving anime adaptations, expanding the genre’s representation beyond shonen dominance.

game_thrones_movie_confirms_director_and.headline: Game of Thrones: Aegon’s Conquest
highlights: The film will be directed by Owen Harris, known for Black Mirror and A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
Screenwriter Beau Willimon, creator of Star Wars: Andor, is attached to the script
The movie is scheduled for a summer blockbuster release on June 1, 2029
It follows the early Targaryen conquest after the events of House of the Dragon and A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
game_thrones_movie_confirms_director_and.why_it_matters: It expands the Game of Thrones cinematic universe and bridges the story between existing TV prequels and the original saga.

dragon_ball_officially_confirms_price_le.headline: Dragon Ball: Shenron & Son Goku LEGO Set
dragon_ball_officially_confirms_price_le.summary: Dragon Ball’s first official LEGO set will launch on November 4, 2026, priced at $179.99.
highlights: The set is part of LEGO Icons and includes 1,764 pieces
It features a Shenron display and a minifigure of Goku riding Nimbus
Retail price is $179.99 USD and it is recommended for ages 18+
dragon_ball_officially_confirms_price_le.why_it_matters: It marks the debut of an official Dragon Ball LEGO product, opening the door for future collaborations and expanding the franchise’s merchandise line.

manga_plus_digimon_eggs_manga_october_ne.headline: Digimon Eggs
manga_plus_digimon_eggs_manga_october_ne.summary: Ayumu Minato's Digimon Eggs manga will debut as a simulpub on Shueisha's Manga Plus platform on October 2, 2026.
highlights: The series will launch simultaneously in Shueisha's Saikyō Jump magazine.
Simplified Chinese and Korean versions will be available on the Digimon Web site.
The announcement was made via the official Digimon franchise X account.
manga_plus_digimon_eggs_manga_october_ne.why_it_matters: It expands the Digimon franchise into the global digital manga market, reaching readers on multiple languages.

nycc_funko_unveils_lineup_variant_figure.headline: Funko Green Lantern Hal Jordan Variant POP! Figures
nycc_funko_unveils_lineup_variant_figure.summary: Funko announced a limited‑edition line of Hal Jordan POP!
highlights: White Lantern and Red Lantern variants each limited to 1,000 units at $40 each
Variants will be sold exclusively at Funko’s NYCC booth #4515 on specific days from Oct 8‑11
Standard Green Lantern figure will be available each day of the convention
No Orange or Indigo Lantern variants were included in this release
nycc_funko_unveils_lineup_variant_figure.why_it_matters: The figures expand the collectible options for DC fans and tie into the current DC Studios Lanterns TV series popularity.

mazenchu_anime_posts_opening_video_narra.headline: Mazenchu
mazenchu_anime_posts_opening_video_narra.summary: The food‑themed TV anime Mazenchu will debut on October 7, 2026, with actress First Summer Uika narrating the opening.
highlights: First Summer Uika provides the opening narration
The series airs on Kansai TV’s morning program Yoidon starting October 7
Directed by Yūsuke Takase at Studio Nanahoshi
Lead voice cast includes Obara Rea, Sakura Hayashi, Uki Nashiki, and Kokoro Kikuchi
mazenchu_anime_posts_opening_video_narra.why_it_matters: It marks the first original anime within Kansai TV’s long‑running morning show, expanding the Mazenchu mascot franchise.

naruto_rev_2026.headline: Naruto (TV) Limited Series Revival
naruto_rev_2026.summary: Naruto’s four‑episode limited TV anime revival will be unveiled at New York Comic Con 2026 with a worldwide YouTube livestream.
highlights: The revival will consist of four new episodes focusing on pre‑Shippuden Team 7 on a brand‑new mission
A panel titled “NARUTO: What’s Next?” at NYCC on October 10, 2026 will reveal the first look, streamed globally on YouTube
Studio Pierrot executive producer Yoshihiro Tominaga, voice actors Junko Takeuchi and Noriaki Sugiyama will attend the panel
The project was originally slated for a September 2023 debut before being placed on indefinite hiatus
naruto_rev_2026.why_it_matters: It marks the long‑awaited return of the original Naruto series for its 20th anniversary, offering fresh canon content for fans.

sumikko_gurashi_5th_film_2027.headline: Sumikko Gurashi
sumikko_gurashi_5th_film_2027.summary: San‑X announced a fifth Sumikko Gurashi anime film slated for release in 2027.
highlights: The fifth film will focus on the character Neko as the protagonist
A visual by creator Yuri Yokomizo was unveiled with the announcement
The franchise has released four previous theatrical films between 2019 and 2025
sumikko_gurashi_5th_film_2027.why_it_matters: It continues the successful Sumikko Gurashi film series, which has consistently drawn sizable audiences in Japan.

katsuwo_launches_manga_adaptation_renren.headline: Ōja no Ban Kuruwase: Net Shōgi no Teiō Manga Adaptation
katsuwo_launches_manga_adaptation_renren.summary: Manga creator Katsuwo launched a manga adaptation of Renren Ii's Ōja no Ban Kuruwase shōgi light novels in Kadokawa's Dengeki Daioh G November issue.
highlights: The adaptation appears on the front cover of the November 2026 issue of Dengeki Daioh G
The story follows Mikado Watanabe, an introverted high‑schooler who is the online "King of Self‑Destruction" shōgi player
Renren Ii's original light novels began serialization on Kadokawa's Kakuyomu site in December 2023 and are ongoing
katsuwo_launches_manga_adaptation_renren.why_it_matters: Bringing the popular shōgi novel series to manga broadens its audience and highlights Katsuwo's growing portfolio of adaptations.

mha_update_2026.headline: My Hero Academia
mha_update_2026.summary: My Hero Academia will appear at Jump Festa 2027 in December, teasing a potential major anime update.
highlights: The franchise will showcase a stage presentation at Jump Festa 2027 on December 19‑20, 2026
Two new specials have already aired, adapting the manga’s final chapter
An exclusive My Hero Academia Ultra Expo is scheduled for April 7‑8, 2027, promising further announcements
mha_update_2026.why_it_matters: Fans hope the event will reveal the next big anime project after the series’ official conclusion.

one_the_most_iconic_captain_america_comi.headline: Captain America #1 (1941) CGC VF/NM 9.0 goes to auction
one_the_most_iconic_captain_america_comi.summary: Heritage Auctions is selling a rare CGC VF/NM 9.0 copy of Captain America #1, the debut issue from 1941, with a current bid of $390,400.
highlights: The copy is graded CGC VF/NM 9.0, one of only nine copies at that grade
It features off‑white to white pages, a rarity for Golden Age comics
The issue marks the first appearance of Captain America, Bucky, and Red Skull
Current bid stands at $390,400 including buyer’s premium
one_the_most_iconic_captain_america_comi.why_it_matters: The sale highlights the enduring cultural and monetary value of one of comics’ most historic debut issues.

before_yellowstone_taylor_sheridan_direc.headline: Wind River: The Next Chapter
before_yellowstone_taylor_sheridan_direc.summary: A sequel to Taylor Sheridan's 2017 film Wind River, titled Wind River: The Next Chapter, is in development but has faced post‑production delays.
highlights: The sequel was announced in 2022 and focuses on Chip Hanson, Natalie’s brother
Martin Sensmeier and Gil Birmingham are confirmed to reprise their roles
Jeremy Renner and Elizabeth Olsen have not been announced as part of the cast
The film reportedly finished filming in 2023 but remains locked in legalities as of a 2025 interview
before_yellowstone_taylor_sheridan_direc.why_it_matters: The project continues the story of a critically acclaimed crime thriller that blends Western elements with contemporary issues.

x_men_the_animated_series_lost_cyclops_a.headline: X-Men: The Animated Series – “No Mutant is an Island” aired two years late, creating a continuity error
x_men_the_animated_series_lost_cyclops_a.summary: The 1996 episode “No Mutant is an Island” was intended for season three but aired in season five, causing a major continuity glitch in the series timeline.
highlights: The episode originally aired on September 21, 1996, two years later than its intended placement in season three
Its story follows Cyclops grieving Jean Grey’s funeral, which contradicts her being alive in later episodes of season five
The misplacement adds a new appearance of New Mutants characters Rusty Collins, Skids, Boom Boom, and Wiz Kid
The episode’s delayed airing highlights the chaotic production order of the series’ fifth season
x_men_the_animated_series_lost_cyclops_a.why_it_matters: The error disrupts the series’ narrative flow and affects fans’ understanding of character arcs and timeline continuity

superman_kingdom_of_zod_future.headline: Superman: Kingdom of Zod Special #1
superman_kingdom_of_zod_future.summary: DC Comics released Superman: Kingdom of Zod Special #1, reshaping the future of Superman with major resets and time‑travel fallout.
highlights: The issue introduces Jon Kent’s future as Tomorrow Man, setting up a new father‑and‑son era in Superman Unlimited
Superboy Prime steps away from heroics, while Lex Luthor’s past and present plans drive new threats
The story features a dead General Zod’s Kryptonite kingdom, Ursa’s return, and a Black Lantern ring hinting at larger cosmic stakes
superman_kingdom_of_zod_future.why_it_matters: It establishes the next major narrative direction for Superman and his family across upcoming DC titles

mahoutsukai_no_yoru_movie_2026.headline: Mahoutsukai no Yoru (Anime Film)
mahoutsukai_no_yoru_movie_2026.summary: The ufotable‑produced anime film adaptation of Type‑Moon’s visual novel Mahoutsukai no Yoru revealed its full staff, theme song by supercell, and final trailer, with a theatrical release set for November 20, 2026 in Japan.
highlights: Director Masashi Takeuchi and chief director Hikaru Kondou were announced
Character designer Moe Tsuzuki and chief animation director Masato Nagamori are part of the staff
Supercell will perform the theme song "Yoru to Ao"
The final 90‑second trailer debuted alongside the staff reveal
mahoutsukai_no_yoru_movie_2026.why_it_matters: It marks the first major cinematic entry for the prequel to Fate’s Tsukihime, expanding the Nasuverse on the big screen.

dandadan_confirms_new_update_ahead_new_s.headline: Dandadan
dandadan_confirms_new_update_ahead_new_s.summary: The third season of the Dandadan anime has been confirmed and will receive an update at Jump Festa 2027.
highlights: Third season confirmed for 2027 release
Will be featured on the Super Stage lineup at Jump Festa 2027
Science SARU returns as animation studio
Original voice cast will reprise their roles
dandadan_confirms_new_update_ahead_new_s.why_it_matters: Season 3 continues the popular supernatural‑comedy series and will reveal the mystery girl introduced in the season 2 finale.

new_ted_animated_series_confirms_peacock.headline: Ted: The Animated Series
new_ted_animated_series_confirms_peacock.summary: Seth MacFarlane’s Ted returns as an animated series debuting on Peacock on December 17, 2026.
highlights: First look trailer reveals the animated continuation of the Ted films
Series picks up 12 years after Ted 2 and features original cast members Seth MacFarlane, Mark Wahlberg, Amanda Seyfried, and Jessica Barth
Animation is produced by Rough Draft Studios, Inc.
Eight episodes will launch on Peacock with additional episodes slated for 2027

black_clover_might_be_taking_a_road_that.headline: Black Clover Season 2
black_clover_might_be_taking_a_road_that.summary: The second season of the Black Clover anime is set to begin broadcast in October 2026, continuing the Spade Kingdom arc.
highlights: Studio Pierrot will produce the new season, which starts on October 3, 2026 on TV Tokyo and affiliated stations

Character design by Moe Tsuzuki and new visual by Hirokazu Koyama
Theme song "Yoru to Ao" performed by supercell
Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures will screen the film in the U.S. and Canada on January 29, 2027
witch_the_holy_night_film_s_final_unveil.why_it_matters: The trailer provides the first official look at the film's creative team and music, building anticipation for the upcoming release.

publication_fingerprints.headline: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Releases Creditless Twelfth Ending Featuring "Aoi Yume"
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Releases Creditless Twelfth Ending Featuring "Aoi Yume" Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its twelfth ending, featuring the song “Aoi Yume” by Mori Tsubasa. The song was used in Episodes 140-153, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
The release follows yesterday’s release of the eleventh ending, featuring the song “Smile for…” by Ueto Aya. The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.
These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the latest entry below.

The Savage Sword of Conan: The Original Comics Omnibus Vol. 8 Conan the Barbarian has just made his triumphant return with an exciting new release perfect for fans of the sword-and-sorcery icon. A stunning eighth new omnibus is now on sale from Titan Comics.
The Savage Sword of Conan: The Original Comics Omnibus Vol.8 was released on Sept. 8 with over one thousand pages of digitally remastered artwork and a host of bonus material. The high-quality release collects Savage Sword of Conan (1974) #102-116 as well as Marvel Comics Super Special (1977) #35 in a beautiful and deluxe hardcover format. It picks up the story directly from where the seventh omnibus left off, so Conan fans looking to complete their collection will definitely want to pick up the new release, which has a suggested retail price of $150.
Renowned Conan the Barbarian Illustrator Returns for New Omnibus Release
Titan and Penguin Random House's listing for the Original Comics Omnibus Vol. 8 promises unseen bonus material, a section of "rarely seen artwork" as well as an all-new introduction from Conan comics legend, Gary Kwapisz. Known for his detailed artwork that brought some of Conan's most savage scenes to life, Kwapisz worked not only on The Savage Sword of Conan but also Titan Comics released a deluxe hardcover omnibus collecting Savage Sword of Conan #102‑116 and Marvel Super Special #35 on Sept. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
2026 World Webtoon Awards Announces 20 Finalists, Opens Global Reader Vote Korea's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (MCST) and the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA) announced on Thursday the 20 finalists for the 2026 World Webtoon Awards.
Now in their third year, the awards will accept online votes from readers worldwide from September 17 to October 19. Judges' scores and reader votes will each account for 50% of the final score.
This year's awards received 7,318 nominations from 4,038 fans worldwide, with 941 works submitted in total.
For the first time, the awards will also offer cash prizes. The grand prize winner will receive 15 million won (about US$10,700), while the Judges' Award winner will receive 13 million won (about US$9,400) and other main award winners will receive 10 million won (about US$7,200) each.
The awards ceremony will take place on December 3 at Starfield Library in COEX Mall, Seoul, as part of the World Webtoon Festival, which runs from December 2 to 6.

The new R-rated movie continues the story begun in Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall, which released in August.
As seen in the trailer, Knightquest picks up after Batman and Bane's brutal fight that left Bruce Wayne with a broken back. In the aftermath, Bane declares dominion over Gotham City and releases many of Batman's greatest villains back into the public. To fight back, Bruce passes the mantle to another, Jean-Paul Valley, the religiously zealous vigilante known as Azrael, which comes as a disappointing shock to both Nightwing and Robin.
In the trailer, Azrael dishes out ruthless, brutal, violent justice to criminals, first in Batman's traditional cape and cowl before transitioning to a suit of Batman armor. Check out the trailer below.
The Batman: Knightfall Trilogy Continues in Knightquest

Akira Failing in Love Akira returns to the countryside for high school with a plan to win the heart of her childhood crush! They're both fools in love… because she's too dense to figure out he likes her back!
Harekawa launched the manga in Weekly Shonen Sunday in August 2024. Shogakukan published the manga's first compiled book volume in December 2024, and the eighth volume on September 16. Viz Media published the manga's fourth volume on September 8.
Kadokawa published one compiled book volume of Senpai, This Can't Be Love! in July 2019. Yen Pressreleased the manga in English in June 2024.
Kadokawa published the first volume of Sempai! Danjite Koi de wa! Brush up sequel manga in September 2020, and the second volume in May 2023. Yen Press released the sequel manga's first volume in December 2024.
Harekawa launched the Three Exorcism Siblings (Tengu Barai no San Kyōdai) manga in Coamix's Web Comic Zenyon in 2021. Coamix published the manga's first volume in 2022, and the seventh and final volume in September 2023. Titan Comicslicensed the manga and published the fourth volume in English on July 28.

publication_fingerprints.headline: Akarui Mirai
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Akarui Mirai Kaihō and Kurageso launched the series in Houbunsha's Manga Time Kirara Forward magazine in August 2025. Kaihō writes the story while Kurageso draws the art. Houbunsha shipped the second compiled book volume on July 10.
The manga centers on Mirai, a girl who is not very good at socializing. A foul-mouthed AI from the future tells her she is going to die alone if she doesn't change, but Mirai isn't sure exactly how she is supposed to make friends.
Kaihō and Sadoru Chiba launched the original School-Live! manga in Manga Time Kirara Forward in 2012, and ended the series in November 2019. The manga's 12th and final compiled volume shipped in January 2020. Kaihō and Chiba launchedGakkō Gurashi! ~Otayori~, a sequel to the manga, in Manga Time Kirara Forward in June 2020, and ended it in August 2021.
Kaihō is also known for writing scripts for anime, and wrote the anime adaptation of his School-Live! manga. He was also the head writer on both Danganronpa 3 anime (as well as their "Hope Arc" special), was co-writer alongside Makoto Fukami on the anime adaptation of Fukami's Magical Girl Spec-Ops Asuka manga, and was also co-writer on the Akudama Drive original anime alongside its director Norimitsu Kaihō and Kurageso’s Akarui Mirai manga will conclude with its next chapter in the October 23 issue of Manga Time Kirara Forward. publication_fingerprints.headline: Chiikawa Anime Temporarily Pauses New Episodes for Revival Rebroadcast
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Chiikawa Anime Temporarily Pauses New Episodes for Revival Rebroadcast The official website for the anime of Nagano's Chiikawa manga announced on Friday that the anime will temporarily pause the regular airing of new episodes, and will instead run a "revival" rebroadcast of 25 older "influential" episodes until December 25. The revival rebroadcast will focus on episodes early in the anime's run, as well as episodes that are connected to the recent Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu (Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island) anime film.
The Chiikawaanimepremiered in April 2022, and it previously aired every Friday withinFuji TV's morning news and entertainment program Mezamashi Terebi, before it began airing twice a week on Tuesdays and Fridays in April 2023. Sentai Filmworks licensed the anime, and is streaming it on HIDIVE with English subtitles. ODK Media's North American streaming platform Amasian TV began streaming a selection of 20 episodes from the anime on August 20.
Child actress Haruka Aoki (Liza in the Japanese dub of Mighty Express) voices the titular character Chiikawa as her first television anime voice acting role. Child actor Makoto Tanaka (Okko's Inn) voices Hachiware. Ari Ozawa voices Usagi.

The staff for the anime of Hitsuji Gondaira's Mission: Yozakura Family (Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen) manga revealed a new promotional video for the anime on Friday. The video reveals five new cast members for the anime.
The new cast members include:
Hōchū Ōtsuka as Alexandryu
Miku Itō as Shura
Yumiri Hanamori as Cyber Demon Lord Giga
Sumire Uesaka as Dr. Mozu
Naomi Shindoh as Hulang
The announcement also revealed the character Kosmos Akizakura (seen below), but did not reveal the voice actor for the character.
The second part of the second season will premiere on MBS, TBS, and 26 other channels on October 11 at 5:00 p.m. (4:00 a.m. EDT).
The rock band Humbreaders performs the new anime's opening theme song "Forever Song," and dance and vocal group KID PHENOMENON performs the new ending theme song "I'm Still Breathing."
Disney describes the anime's story:
High school student Taiyou Asano has been socially inept ever since his family died in a car crash. That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 4 News
That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 4 Anime Returns for 3rd Part in July 2027, Clayman's Revenge Spinoff Anime Debuts in April
posted on  by Crystalyn Hodgkins
The staff for the fourth That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime (Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken) anime season revealed on Friday that the anime will return for its third cours (quarter of a year) in July 2027. In addition, the staff revealed that Wataru Kajika's That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: Clayman's Revenge (Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken: Clayman Revenge) spinoff manga will get a television anime that will debut in April 2027.
Takehito Koyasu is returning to the franchise to voice Clayman.
Kentarō Sugimoto (episode director for Blue Lock, Laid-Back Camp TV 3) is directing the spinoff anime at 8-Bit. Yūji Haibara, who handled graphic design for previous entries in the franchise, is overseeing the series scripts. Asumi Hashimoto (sub-character design for The irregular at magic high school TV 3) and Hideki Sakai (chief animation director for previous entries in the franchise) are designing the characters.

Horror Collector The 13th season of American Horror Story, simply subtitled 13, debuted its first three episodes yesterday, Sept. 24, and it's already breaking records with audiences — just not the types of records the series was hoping for. Season 13 currently has the lowest Rotten Tomatoes audience score of all previous seasons.
American Horror Story's 13th season has a 32% audience score on Rotten Tomatoes. A critic score has not yet been compiled, but the show overall across seasons has a 77% critic score and a 64% audience score. Aside from 13, only four other seasons of the horror anthology series have garnered below a 60% Rotten Tomatoes audience score, with NYC (Season 11) at 42%, Double Feature (Season 10) at 50%, Cult (Season 7) at 52%, and Roanoke (Season 6) at 57%.
Season 13 Was Highly Anticipated
Unlike previous seasons of American Horror Story, which are mostly standalone stories, possibly with some tangential connection to a previous season, 13 connects to almost every tale told previously in the anthology series.

The new short anime is titled Shin Seiki GPX Cyber Formula ASURADA, and is a direct sequel to the 1998 Future GPX Cyber Formula Sin anime.
Character designer Hirokazu Hisayuki and chief mechanical animation director Satoshi Shigeta drew the below poster for the new anime short.
Series director Mitsuo Fukuda is overseeing the new "movie edition" of Future GPX Cyber Formula: Early Days Renewal.

Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun First Theatrical Anime Film Project Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun is getting its first theatrical anime film project. The project announcement video was revealed during the DEVIL’S PARTY! 2 event held at Nippon Engineering College Arena in Tokyo on September 27.
Ayumu Murase, who voices Iruma Suzuki, shared the following comment:
“I think it’s going to develop into something that makes you wonder, ‘What’s going to happen!?’ I’m really looking forward to it myself, and I hope everyone will come out to see it as well. For now, I’ll do my best with the recording, so please look forward to it!”
Series creator Osamu Nishi also commented:
“More than anything, I’m really looking forward to it. I’ve been told by the people around me not to say anything, so I can’t really say anything (laughs), but we’re working very hard on it, so I hope you’ll wait patiently.”
You can watch the announcement video below.
The Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun anime is based on Osamu Nishi’s manga serialized in Weekly Shonen Champion, which has 50 volumes published as of September 8, 2026. The anime premiered in 2019. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime, describing the story:

One Piece ONE PIECE TV anime announced a 2027 return following the release of Episode 1180, this year’s final episode, on September 27. The anime has concluded its run for this year, having returned after a 3-month break on April 5. Yuichi Nakamura was revealed as the voice of Loki, and he made his debut in the Elbaph Arc alongside the cast for the Knights of God.
Today’s episode is titled “Elbaph in Despair – Diabolical Covenant, ‘Domi Reversi’” and it is now streaming on Crunchyroll. You can see the end card for the episode below.
ONE PIECE manga by Eiichiro Oda first began in July 1997, and the series exceeded 600 million circulating copies worldwide in March this year. It also celebrated the 25th anniversary in 2022, while the anime adaptation started in October 1999 and is also still going strong.
The anime also debuted new theme songs for the ongoing arc. The opening song’s title is “Luminous,” and it’s performed by AiNA THE END. The ending song is “That Future” by Jisoku 36km.

Long-Running Anime Series with 100+ Episodes Highlighted by CBR There is no shortage of outstanding anime series that don’t need more than a dozen episodes to fully captivate their audiences. However, considering how many of the medium’s all-time fan-favorite titles span hundreds of episodes, there’s no denying that ambitious, long-running anime series have their intrinsic appeal.
Long anime series are not for everyone; they are a substantial time commitment and seldom manage to keep their quality consistent without losing momentum or falling back on filler. However, among them, there exist remarkable examples of long-term storytelling that make sticking around for 100+ episodes worth it, to the point of viewers wishing these adventures could go on forever.

The Mummy 4 Production is underway on The Mummy 4 ahead of the film's release in 2027. While the long wait continues for the sequel, new images have revealed a first look at Rachel Weisz's long-awaited return to the franchise.
Amid filming in the UK, Weisz was spotted filming scenes for her return as Evelyn O'Connell in The Mummy 4. Images of her in full costume were taken and have been quickly spreading online. Fans are very excited to see the photos, and it's no wonder why they are going viral. This is the first time Weisz has been seen in the role of Evelyn since appearing in the second Mummy movie in 2001, at which point she exited the franchise.
Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz Finally Reunite
The Mummy 4, which has not yet had its official title announced, reunites Weisz with franchise star Brendan Fraser. It's believed that the new sequel will ignore the third installment of the franchise, 2008's The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor. After Weisz played Evelyn in 1999's The Mummy and 2001's The Mummy Returns, she did not return for the third film. Her role was recast with Maria bello taking over.

Tetsuya Chiba Puts Hinemosu Notari Nikki Manga on Hiatus Due to Poor Health
posted on  by Joanna Cayanan
This year's 19th issue of Shogakukan's Big Comic magazine announced on Friday that Tetsuya Chiba's Hinemosu Notari Nikki manga will go on hiatus due to Chiba's poor health. The magazine's editorial staff stated that Chiba is eager to resume the manga's serialization as soon as possible, but the editorial department will prioritize Chiba's health and recovery.
In a separate statement by Chiba, he stated that the severe summer heat might be the cause of him feeling under the weather. Chiba added that he will focus on recovering to get back to drawing manga again. He apologizes for the worry he has caused, and asks for the readers' patience as he takes some time to recover.
Chiba launched the autobiographical short essay manga in Big Comic in December 2015. AD Police Files (1990) 4K Restoration Bubblegum Crisis was one of the premier cyberpunk anime franchises of its day, known for its signature, almost sacrilegious use of bright colors and a pop music-esque aesthetic within the genre. Now, its contentious sequel is getting a modernized update, and the upgraded version finally has a release date.
AD Police Files was known for being very different compared to Bubblegum Crisis, but it's since become a cult classic in its own right. A modern 4K restoration of the 1990s OVA is on the way, offering viewers a better glimpse at its grit and gore. The newly released trailer is just a taste of how beautiful it still is, and the 4K edition is the version fans have waited over three decades for.
One of the Most Brutal '90s Cyberpunk OVAs Gets a 4K Upgrade
Announced at Anime Expo 2026 by AnimeEigo, the 4K version of AD Police Files comes from the OVA's original negative. This was one of five announcements at the event, though it's easily the most notable.
Set to be released as a Blu-ray and UHD combo pack, this version of AD Police Files will include the original Japanese dub (with English subtitles), the US English dub, the UK English dub and more. publication_fingerprints.headline: Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret manga is getting an anime series. A visual was revealed, along with the main staff and cast, and an April 2027 release date. Studio Gekko is animating the series.
The voice cast consists of:
- Reiji Kawashima as Hizashi Hiruno
- Hikaru Tono as Rei Kuromiya
- Iori Noguchi as Sakura Akai
- Ami Maeshima as Sora Konno
Hikaru Sato is directing the anime with Fumihiko Shimo in charge of the series scripts. Kibidango 14-go is the character designer, while Satoru Kosaki and MONACA compose the music.
Kashiko Amane writes and illustrates the manga that the anime is based on. Hakusensha is publishing the manga since September 2022. Yen Press is licensing it in English, describing the plot as follows:
Hizashi Hiruno, a freshman at a super-elite high school, has just finished his first academic proficiency test of the year. He anxiously awaits the results, which will set the tone for his next three years at school. But due to a mistake on his answer sheet, he receives an abysmal score and gets sent to remedial lessons! If there’s one silver lining, he’s not the only one—and his comrade could be the girl of his dreams?!

Pokémon Winds & Waves Regional Dex Reveal Pokémon Winds and Waves likely won't be receiving any additional updates until early 2027. Thankfully, through various sources, both official and unofficial, quite a bit is known about the Generation 10 games, especially where the Pokémon are concerned.
Between old favorites and new friends, a total of 54 Pokémon have been revealed as part of the Regional Dex for Pokémon Winds and Waves. This list includes some obvious suspects, some more out there choices fans might not expect and, of course, already beloved additions to the franchise like the new Starter Trio, Pombon, Browt, and Gecqua.
54 Pokémon Officially Confirmed For Pokémon Winds and Waves
The Pokémon most prominently featured in the announced trailer for Pokémon Winds and Waves were, unsurprisingly, the new Starter Trio and the franchise's eternal mascot. Pombon, the Fire-type, Browt, the Grass-type, and Gecqua, the Water-type, have quickly won the hearts of fans, with fans in mass speculating about what their evolutions will look like. Pikachu, meanwhile, will not only be catchable as always, but two specific Pikachus are being featured as prominent characters in the games.
